nodes.label: Indoor Group Gathering Test Image
nodes.description: Candid indoor photo inside a Japanese restaurant / izakaya: about twenty people, mostly a lab or office group, clapping while a woman hands a decorated cake to a man in a green polo. Visible secondary objects include dining tables, bowls, chopsticks, drinking glasses, a cake, a wristwatch, chairs and a wall poster. A mid-density, multi-class, mixed-scale indoor scene under warm artificial light.

nodes.label: Multi-Class Cluttered Indoor Scene Detection
nodes.rationale: Exercises the breadth of the COCO class vocabulary rather than just 'person': cake, dining table, bowl, cup, chair and clock-like objects co-occur at very different scales in one frame. This confirms the pretrained head decodes the full 80-class output correctly before the model is repurposed for the single-class poultry problem.
